variants.title: Missing reproduction
variants.comment: Thanks for reporting this. To investigate it, we need a minimal reproduction: exact URL or Blueprint, browser/runtime version, expected behavior, actual behavior, and any console/error output. If you can add that, we can triage the next step.

variants.title: Needs benchmark
variants.comment: This looks plausible, but we need measurements before reviewing a change. Could you add a before/after benchmark or profiling output, plus the command or steps used to collect it?

variants.title: Public API / contract
variants.comment: Thanks — this touches a public Playground contract, so we should agree on the shape before implementation review. Please move this into a proposal with the user problem, non-goals, affected APIs, compatibility risks, test plan, and smallest first slice.

variants.title: Product direction
variants.comment: This is useful directionally, but it needs product/design agreement before code review. Please move it to a proposal or GitHub Discussion with the user journey, alternatives considered, and the smallest change that would validate the idea.

variants.title: Small scoped change
variants.comment: This looks scoped and reviewable. Next step: maintainer review, with tests/manual verification checked before merge.

variants.title: Issue has implementation
variants.comment: Thanks for the clear report. This already has a candidate PR, so the next step is to review and test that PR against the reproduction here.

variants.title: Author responded to feedback
variants.comment: Thanks for following up. The next step is a re-test/re-review from the previous reviewer or area maintainer to confirm whether the latest update resolves the reported issue.

variants.title: Multiple candidate PRs
variants.comment: There are multiple candidate fixes. The next step is to choose one implementation path before asking for more review, then close or split the alternatives.

variants.title: Small patch vs broader PR
variants.comment: There is a small candidate fix and a broader candidate. Prefer the smallest patch that fully solves the reported problem, and split broader layout work into follow-ups if needed.

variants.title: Large PR needs slices
variants.comment: The direction may be useful, but this is too large to review safely as one PR. Please split it into an implementation plan and the smallest first slice with standalone value. We can resume implementation review once the slice plan is clear.

variants.title: No reviewer capacity
variants.comment: This looks useful and aligned, but we do not currently have maintainer capacity to review or carry it. Leaving it marked as needing capacity; the path back is for someone to volunteer as owner, propose the smallest reviewable slice, and stay with it through follow-up.

variants.title: No reviewer capacity
variants.comment: This remains a valid area of work, but we do not currently have a clear owner or reviewer capacity. Leaving this marked as needing an owner; a good next step would be for someone to propose the smallest owned slice and volunteer to maintain it through review.

variants.title: Insufficient information
variants.comment: Closing this because we do not have enough information to act on it. If someone can reproduce it with current Playground, please open a fresh issue with a minimal URL or Blueprint, exact steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, and console/error output.

variants.title: Out of scope
variants.comment: Thanks for the suggestion. This is outside the current scope of WordPress Playground, so we are closing it to keep the queue focused. A future proposal can link back here if the scope changes and there is a concrete owner.

variants.title: No response after follow-up
variants.comment: Closing this because we asked for more information and have not received enough detail to move it forward. If someone can still reproduce this in current Playground, please open a fresh issue with the exact URL or Blueprint, steps, expected behavior, actual behavior, and console/error output.

variants.title: Research note / not scheduled
variants.comment: This is useful context, but it is not current actionable work. Closing to keep the issue queue reviewable. Future proposals can link back to this discussion when there is a concrete use case, owner, and first slice.
